title: "Aakriti's Animint Gallery"
output: 
  html_document:
    self_contained: false

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)

# 1. Read the data
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv')

# 2. Build the exact links
image_links <- paste0("[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/)", dt$viz_owner_repo, "/main/Capture.PNG")

creator_info <- strsplit(dt$viz_owner_repo, split="/")
CreatorName <- sapply(creator_info, `[`, 1)
RepoName <- sapply(creator_info, `[`, 2)

viz_links <- paste0("https://", CreatorName, ".github.io/", RepoName, "/")

# 3. Create the display data frame
display_df <- data.frame(
  Screenshot = "",
  Project = paste0("<b>", dt$title, "</b>"),
  Links = paste0("<a href='", viz_links, "'>Interactive Demo</a><br>",
                 "<a href='", dt$source, "'>Source Code</a>")
)

# 4. Generate the table
kable(display_df, format = "html", escape = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = TRUE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
  column_spec(1, image = image_links)
